[spoiler=
[b]EMU COAST[/b]
[i]Prologue[/i]

WORD COUNT: 306/555
[pre]+306[/pre]]
[i]A great plume of fire rises from an inky black void. It makes no sound in the first seconds of its birth. It does not howl, crackle or screech in fury. It casts a brilliant red and orange light on the landscape around it; such is its brilliance that all biological matter near it catches fire.

The plume begins to form a bulb at the top. It is beginning to fold over on itself. Its shockwave finally reaches our ears. To us, it sounds like and feels like a powerful gust of wind. Looking at it, the plume has now formed into the unmistakeable outline of a mushroom.

Far off in the distance, safely away from the explosion, like prairie dogs, a mass of people rise up from behind their trenches and embankments. All of them are dressed in military fatigues and are wearing goggles to protect their eyes from the harsh light of the cloud. They look on at their creation, stunned silent by the sheer magnitude of the final product of their hard work.

In a split second, and by the sheer willpower of their determination to build, they have created a fireball that is - or was - hotter than the surface of Ardaga.

The plume begins to cool down. It turns into a shade of deep red, before finally disappearing into the night from which it arose from.

It takes the people a few seconds to react to what they have laid witness to. Suddenly, they erupt into a cacophony of cheering and clapping, congratulating each other and hugging one another in pure joy.

One man remains still, looking out over into the void ahead. He doesn't congratulate himself or his peers around him.

He is shaken to his core.

And in his mind, he believes only one thing.

He has created a monster.[/i]
[/spoiler]
